summary.text: Alex Harlan is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 42A in Baltimore County and has served since August 3, 2026. His official page lists him on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Harlan's official page says he was born in Baltimore in 1997, graduated from Dulaney High School in 2016, and earned a B.A. in political science from Penn State University in 2020 and an M.S. in counter-terrorism and homeland security from American University in 2022.
It lists him as an assistant chief of staff to Senator Chris West in the Maryland General Assembly from 2021 to 2025 and a research associate at the Orion Policy Institute from 2023.
The page also lists him as a firefighter with the Jacksonville Volunteer Fire Company since 2015.
